limitations: External models are not retrained or calibrated on external labels.
HalluHard seed prompts are coverage-only because public seeds have no gold labels.
Answer quality and monetary token cost require an LLM generation run and are not inferred from labels.

The HaluEval right/hallucinated pair shares its prompt, history and evidence exactly, so its AUROC is a pre-generation purity check (0.5 means the score cannot be using the response), not a generalisation test.

The HaluEval counterfactual set is derived from the same public prompts: the unsupported variant is given another record's knowledge document, so the label is a property of the context, not of a response.
